title: Pretty Towel!
text: Pretty Towel!. When this towel arrived, the first thing I noticed was that it was pretty thin. I thought maybe it was one of those microfiber towels, but it's not! It's a real terrycloth towel. And while it's thin, it's not cheap feeling. It's absorbent and quick drying. It easily fits around my plus size body. Plus, it's pretty & colorful. I am very happy with my new towel!
